snippet.title: The pre-registration for Oh My Dog is now available！
snippet.description:
😻The pre-registration for Oh My Dog is now available！

Global first dog idle game?!

💥More than one hundred dog heroes are with you in battle, 
Let's fight against the enemies together!

Super fun battle experience,
Super rich gameplay mechanisms,
Super luxurious pre-order gifts!👻

❤️Go to the registration page to collect your gift: https://ohmydog.joynetgame.com/p-reg
#OhMyDogGame
